name: Valerian Rivers
source:
The doctor at the village hospital. He is mistrusted by all as he was not born in the village, and he makes himself even more unpopular by being rude and abrasive, and refusing to go to church. He appears haughty and aloof, but has a childish side, and loves arguing (but only if he can win).


(Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/this-world-unknown/]website[/url])
